title: 第九十章 寂灭第八十九章 怕死的大名
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
大名看来，波风冥帝要是不使用那眼睛的力量！那没什么可怕的！剩下来的十个守护忍绝对可以对付波风冥帝了。
于是大名为了自己的能活下来，便是厚着脸皮说出了这句话来！这句话一出，卡卡西等人不由愣住了，火之国的大名，原来就是这么一个货色！
“看你这么无耻的份上！可以！”波风冥帝点了点头！大名都这么不要脸了，看在他不要脸的份上，波风冥帝便是点了点他了！
“老哥！”鸣人焦急的叫了起来！佐助，卡卡西他们也是看向了波风冥帝，想劝波风冥帝不要上当了！
而波风冥帝则是摇了摇头，朝着鸣人等人道“放心吧！我的力量，可不只是眼睛而已！”
波风冥帝眼眸的“六”再次消失！守护忍十个人不由喘了几口气，他们看见自己的同伴就那么自杀了，对于波风冥帝惊恐万分！
但是他们也听到波风冥帝说不动用那眼眸的瞳术了，于是全都死死的看向了波风冥帝！
“你们要是以为可以打败我，就尽管上吧！”波风冥帝淡淡的道！
“什么？这个小子太嚣张了吧！”
“他以为我们守护忍那么好对付吗？”
“我们曾经也是名声显著的忍者啊！！！”
守护忍都怒不可遏，都是气愤了起来，想压迫波风冥帝好看！大名很满意守护忍愤怒的样子！只要他们十个人愤怒了，而且波风冥帝还不动用那神秘的瞳术，大名想来波风冥帝必死无疑了！仿佛看到了鸣人被制住的场景，竟然不顾场合的哈哈大笑了起来。
三代心中则有了担忧的预感！
波风冥帝，真的那么好杀吗？
波风冥帝看着狂笑的大名，便是伸出了一根手指头对着守护忍“对付你们这些人，我一根手指头就够了！”
“什么？”十个守护忍面面相觑！都是一脸愤怒至极的样子，恨不得将波风冥帝杀死！
而波风冥帝伸出那一根手指头之后，一股波涛澎湃的杀气，便是从波风冥帝的身上狂涌而出！
当着三代，大名，长老，守护忍，卡卡西等人感受到这足以活活压抑死人的无边杀气的时候，都是一脸难以置信了！
更有一些忍者已经被这股惊涛杀气震慑的双腿颤抖的跪倒在了地面之上！
“就算不用瞳术！我也不是你们几个可以对付的！”波风冥帝淡淡的道！

波风冥帝身为银色恶魔！这些年来，不知道杀了多少人！他们每一个人都有名有姓！
都是有实力的人！而波风冥帝杀他们，从没动用瞳术！三代看着此刻波风冥帝杀气凛然的眼神，心里竟然不觉得有些发毛！
而守护忍都是咽了咽口水！他们知道他们面对的可是传闻之中的杀神，银色恶魔！他们想来波风冥帝能杀那么多人，多半是因为那神秘的瞳术！要是不用瞳术，波风冥帝那么少年，那么小，就算厉害也不会厉害到哪里去！
十个守护忍觉得自己不是没有机会，十个人一起上，一定可以收拾掉波风冥帝！十个人都觉得要是能杀了波风冥帝，那么一定可以成名！
但是他们错了！此刻的波风冥帝，也不是他们可以应付的了的！
“雷切！”
“螺旋丸！”
content_en:
From the daimyo's perspective, if Namikaze Hades didn't use the power of those eyes! That's nothing to be afraid of! The remaining ten guardian ninja can definitely deal with Namikaze Hades.
So the Daimyo shamelessly said this in order to survive! As soon as these words came out, Kakashi and others couldn't help but be stunned. The Daimyo of the Fire Country turned out to be such a thing!
"Looking at how shameless you are! Okay!" Emperor Namikaze nodded! The daimyo is so shameless, and for the sake of his shamelessness, Namikaze Hades just clicked on him!
"Brother!" Naruto shouted anxiously! Sasuke, Kakashi and the others also looked at Namikaze Hades, trying to persuade Namikaze Hades not to be fooled!
Namikaze Hades shook his head and said to Naruto and others, "Don't worry! My power is not just about my eyes!"
The "six" in Namikaze Hades' eyes disappeared again! The ten guardian ninja couldn't help but take a few breaths. They saw their companions committing suicide like that, and they were terrified of Namikaze Hades!
But they also heard that Namikaze Hades said that he couldn't use the pupil technique of those eyes, so they all looked at Namikaze Hades!
"If you think you can defeat me, just go ahead!" Namikaze Hades said calmly!
"What? This kid is too arrogant!"
"Does he think we guardian nin are so easy to deal with?"
"We were once famous ninjas!!!"
The guardian ninja were all furious, they were all angry and wanted to force Namikaze Hades to look good! The daimyo was very satisfied with the angry look of the guardian nin! As long as the ten of them are angry, and Namikaze Hades doesn't use the mysterious eye technique, the daimyo will definitely die if Namikaze Hades comes! As if he saw Naruto being restrained, he laughed regardless of the occasion.
Sandai had a worrying premonition in his heart!
Is Emperor Namikaze really that easy to kill?
Namikaze Hade looked at the laughing daimyo and stretched out a finger to the guardian ninja, "To deal with you people, one finger of mine is enough!"
"What?" The ten guardian ninjas looked at each other! They all looked extremely angry, wanting to kill Namikaze Hades!
And after Namikaze Hade stretched out that finger, a surging murderous aura surged out from Namikaze Hade's body!
When the third generation, daimyo, elders, guardian ninja, Kakashi and others felt the boundless murderous aura that could suppress a dead man alive, they all had expressions of disbelief!
Some ninjas were already frightened by the murderous aura and their legs were trembling and they knelt down on the ground!
"Even if you don't use the pupil technique! I'm not something you can deal with!" Namikaze Hades said calmly!
Namikaze Hades is a silver demon! I don’t know how many people have been killed over the years! Each of them has a name!
They are all capable people! And Emperor Namikaze never used the pupil technique to kill them! The third generation looked at the murderous eyes of Namikaze Hades at this moment, and he didn't even feel a little embarrassed in his heart!
And the guardian ninja swallowed their saliva! They knew that they were facing the rumored God of Death, the Silver Demon! They thought that Namikaze Hades was able to kill so many people, probably because of that mysterious pupil technique! If he didn't use the pupil technique, Namikaze Hades would be so young and young, even if he was powerful, he wouldn't be that powerful!
The ten guardian ninja felt that they had no chance. If ten of them came together, they would definitely be able to deal with Emperor Namikaze! All ten people felt that if they could kill Namikaze Hades, they would definitely become famous!
But they were wrong! The current Emperor Namikaze is no longer something they can handle!
"Raikiri!"
"Rasengan!"
